title: Sneaker ad (Tour)
script:
Built for the court, styled for the block.
Lighter than your Spotify Wrapped is embarrassing.
Smooth as a Frank Ocean deep cut.
Classic as a Sunday night with The Simpsons.
New drop. Your city. Your move.

promo.show: A one-night sneaker launch party with a live DJ set

note: Original ad copy for a fictional brand. Beats: the heatmap changes by city (Frank Ocean green in Houston and Atlanta, amber elsewhere in testing); The Simpsons is red for 18-34 everywhere; RoomRead writes an Atlanta promo blurb and checks its own copy.
